name: com.renameproof/name-checker
title: Renameproof
description: Check app and startup names: domains and who uses them, App Store, Google Play, GitHub, npm.

tools.name: screen_names
tools.description: Quickly check up to 10 candidate app, product or startup names. For each name it reports whether the .com and .app domains are registered (and, for a taken .com, what business or page is on it), whether an app with that name is on the US App Store or Google Play, and whether the GitHub name and npm package are taken. Use it on every name before suggesting it. Takes about 5 to 30 seconds.

names.description: Candidate names, e.g. ["pawtrail", "leashly"]. Spaces are removed; letters, numbers and hyphens only.

tools.name: check_name
tools.description: Check one name in depth: 7 domain endings (.com, .app, .io, .ai, .co, .dev, .net) and who uses each taken one, the App Store in the US, UK, India and Germany, Google Play, common iOS bundle IDs and Android package names, GitHub and npm. Returns a link to the full Renameproof report, which adds look-alike domains and a same-field verdict. Takes about 20 to 40 seconds.

description.description: Optional: what the product is for, e.g. "a dog walking app". Passed to the full report link.
